spans.s:
गेह गेह, अम्, n. (corrupted fr. गृह), a
house, a dwelling, a habitation.
—गेह-दाह, अस्, m.
the burning of a house, a conflagration.
—गेह-पति,
इस्, m. the master of a house, a householder, husband.
—गेह-भू, ऊस्, f. the site of a house, the ground
on which it is built.
—गेहे-क्ष्वेडिन्, ई, इनी, इ,
blustering at home, a house-hero, a coward.
—गेहे-
दाहिन्, ई, इनी, इ, scorching and burning at home, a
house-hero.
—गेहे-दृप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, overbearing
at home.
—गेहे-धृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, insolent at
home.
—गेहे-नर्दिन्, ई, इनी, इ, shouting defiance
at home, a poltroon, a dunghill-cock.
—गेहे-मेहिन्,
ई, इनी, इ, making water at home; a lazy, effeminate
or indolent man.
—गेहे-विजितिन्, ई, इनी, इ, victorious
at home, a cowardly boaster.
—गेहे-व्याड, अस्, m.
fierce at home, a braggart, a boaster.
—गेहे-शूर,
अस्, m. a house-hero, a carpet-knight, a boasting
coward.
—गेहोपवन (˚ह-उप्˚), अम्, n. a small
forest near a house.

गेहिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having a house, domestic; (ई),
m. a householder; (इनी), f. a housewife, a wife.

गेह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. domestic, being in a
house; (अम्), n. domestic affairs; wealth.
